title: Running activity with developer fields
description: Road running activity recorded 2024-12-10, 47:09 / 7.6 km, on a Garmin fenix 6 with HRM Pro, Stryd, Moxy, and two third-party developer devices (CORE body temperature, Concept2). 2,831 record rows, monotonic timestamps, no duplicates. The file itself is clean — its value is as a control for parsers that need to handle FIT developer-field declarations and the corresponding developer-data records without crashing or silently dropping data.
expected_behavior: Parser should return 2,831 records, populate the standard columns, and either expose developer fields (CORE body temperature, Concept2 metrics) or skip them cleanly. A parser that crashes on developer field definitions is broken; a parser that silently discards them without warning is also questionable.
